lines.text: In 1958, the U.S. Air Force planned to nuke the Moon.

lines.text: A top-secret study, called Project A one-nineteen.

lines.text: The Soviet Union had taken an early lead in the Space Race.

parts.tts: The Soviet Union had taken an early lead in the Space Race.

lines.text: So the idea was a show of force, to boost morale back home.

lines.text: Fire a small nuclear warhead at the Moon... and set it off on impact.

lines.text: But here's the wild part... a young Carl Sagan was on the team.
